negative_reproduction.inputs: Ephemeral synthetic public certificate DER followed by invented trailing bytes or a second copy of the same certificate DER, encoded together inside one PEM base64 envelope.
negative_reproduction.observed_openssl_behavior: openssl x509 -in <synthetic-file> -outform DER succeeds and returns only the first certificate DER.
negative_reproduction.verified_boundary: The helper compares every decoded PEM byte against parsed DER and rejects both checksum-consistent hidden-trailer variants with an explicit IntegrityError.

payload.remaining_evidence: A local canary test does not establish backup origin/durability, actual host secret recovery, source-use authority, newly connected hosted execution timing or activation approval. Secret inventory HTTP403 reported by integration owner means unknown availability, not proof that no secret exists.
payload.remaining_owner_input: Identify the existing owner-controlled private durable backup/retrieval arrangement for the original operational key. Recommended: an already-used secure-file password manager; an existing encrypted offline backup is an alternative. Never paste key material into chat.
